description: Real-time flight verification (~8 seconds): queries airlines and OTAs live for exact dates to confirm bookable EUR prices right now, operating airlines, flight numbers, widebody vs narrowbody aircraft on each leg, and a `directCheckoutLink` that opens the airline or OTA booking cart directly. Call this when the user is ready to verify or book specific dates.

depart_date.description: Outbound date (YYYY-MM-DD, today to 330 days ahead).

from.description: City name (e.g. "Milan", "New York") or 3-letter IATA city/airport code (e.g. "MIL", "JFK").

return_date.description: Return date; omit for one way (YYYY-MM-DD, today to 330 days ahead). Optional: the booking link then opens the search on the traveller's dates instead of the quoted fare's.

to.description: City name (e.g. "Milan", "New York") or 3-letter IATA city/airport code (e.g. "MIL", "JFK").

name: verify_live_flight_offers
title: Verify real-time bookable Business/First Class flights, aircraft & direct checkout cart
